title: Curve#classify()
evidence: Paper cubic classification labels and associated roots have no directly equivalent public classifier; preserved for potential geometry-specific adapters.

title: Curve#getTimeAt()
evidence: Negative end-relative distances translated to start-relative distances; round trips use Gleam length, not Paper length. Invalid distances asserted as errors.

title: Curve#getLocationAt()
evidence: Paper null maps to documented InvalidLengthDistance; test uses point-at-length rather than a mutable CurveLocation object.

title: Curve#isStraight()
evidence: No equivalent public isStraight predicate; control-point collinearity alone would lose overshoot/reversal semantics.

title: Curve#isLinear()
evidence: No equivalent public isLinear predicate; linear parameterization differs from straight geometric trace.

title: Curve#getTimeOf()
evidence: 100 segment/point projection checks across 40 rectangle points; distance verifies membership before using projected parameter.

title: Curve#divideAt(offset)
evidence: Two immutable segment divisions preserve source midpoint and reconstruct original parameterized geometry.

title: Curve#getTimesWithTangent()
evidence: Seven explicit direction cases mapped to supporting-line roots of the quadratic derivative; zero-speed candidates explicitly excluded in these fixtures. Missing-direction assertion has no equivalent.
